column3: Manami Route ・ Just like a Galge
A-Anyway!
To be honest, I gotta ask you not to suddenly make me bentos in the future...
Eh?
So it really... was a bother then...
Stupid! How stupid of me!  Why did I have to go and say that?!
But, if I didn't, she probably would have made one again...
There's no other way... there really isn't any other way!
Ma-Manami...
Okay, I get it!
Eh?
From now on, when I make a bento, I'll be sure to ask you first!
A-Ahh... Thanks for that.
Even having said that, I know she didn't mean any harm...
Listen, it's really not a big deal. It's just, y'know, I don't want to force you to make one for me every day.
Oh, I don't mind though?
I'd feel bad! ...Also...
Also?
N-Nothing, don't worry about it!
...?  You're being suspicious, Kyou-chan!
Eating homemade food every day; it'd be like we're married... There's no way I could say something like that!
...*burp*
Kyo-Kyouu-chaaan
Oh boy, this isn't good. That was more food that I thought. And with Manami there, all calm and relaxed, I can't resist even one second longer...
*yawn*
Kyou-chan, are you sleepy?
Haaah, I ate so much, I'm getting tired...
Uh, do you want to... sleep on my lap?
Eh?
What did she just say?
...*yawn*... Sleepy...
A lap pillow, hmm...?
Manami's lap does look quite comfortable...
No, I don't mean it in a weird way. But I can see her thighs peeking out from her skirt.  They look, I don't know, "normal" maybe isn't the right word... I just
mean she's not like some Idol in a magazine or anything...
But it does seem to be a rather pleasant place to sleep...
Kyou-chan?
Uh, no no Manami. Where are we now?
W-Where? Obviously, in the classroom?
Exactly, the classroom. Using a lap pillow in that kind of place is, well, you know...
Oh, really? That's true! My bad, my bad...
Right?!
So, if I had said "Just kidding", she actually would have let me?
But, in a relationship, I guess things like this are normal...
Really, dating has put me in a lot of unexpected situations... Phew.
